name: trailing-prompt
note: The boundary rule applied to the TAIL, which is the one shape a re-grouping cannot reach: Claude worked 10:00-10:01, Craig typed at 10:03, and the turn that prompt opened has no turn_duration record yet, so it contributes no interval and there is no later component to group away from. Leaving the segment open would forecast from 10:00 — before the prompt — which is the defect in miniature. It closes at human_input instead, and the session simply has no open segment until Claude's reply becomes observable. `check_back` is null there, and null is the honest answer: something IS running, we just cannot see it yet.
